# canregtools

## Overview

Canregtools is an R package designed to streamline the analysis workflow
for Population-Based Cancer Registry (PBCR) data. It aims to improve the
efficiency, accuracy, and reproducibility of cancer registry data
processing, thereby supporting standardized, and routine PBCR analytical
workflows.

## Install

Currently, the package is not available on CRAN, but you can install the
development version of canregtools from
<https://gigu003.r-universe.dev/>.

``` r

install.packages('canregtools', repos = c('https://gigu003.r-universe.dev', 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))
```

## View the vignette

After installing `canregtools`, list the available vignettes or open the
main user guide directly:

``` r

browseVignettes("canregtools")
vignette("using-canregtools", package = "canregtools")
```

The vignette explains the `canreg` and `fbswicd` objects,
data-management functions such as
[`cr_select()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_select.md)
and
[`cr_filter()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_filter.md),
and the workflow for calculating rates and quality indicators. It is
also available in the package website at
[`articles/using-canregtools.html`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/articles/using-canregtools.html).

## Usage

``` r

library(canregtools)
data("canregs")
registry <- canregs[[1]]
summary_object <- count_canreg(registry, cancer_type = "big")

asr <- create_asr(summary_object, year, sex, cancer)
quality <- create_quality(summary_object, cancer)
age_rate <- create_age_rate(summary_object)
```

Registry dictionaries can be isolated by project. User overrides are
combined with built-in defaults and take effect immediately:

``` r

options(canregtools.dict_dir = file.path("config", "canregtools"))
mapping <- data.frame(
  regicode = c("410103", "410307"),
  area_type = c("910000", "920000"),
  hdi = c("high", "low")
)
cr_map(mapping, attr = c("area_type", "hdi"))
ls_dict("hdi")
```

Use
[`write_regicode()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/write_regicode.md)
for multilingual registry labels and
[`reset_dict()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/reset_dict.md)
to clear overrides with a backup. Legacy files are backed up on their
next update; see the vignette for migration details.

The main workflow is:

``` text
Excel/data frames -> canreg(s) -> fbswicd(s)
                  -> rates, quality indicators, and reports
```

For detailed input requirements, data-management functions, validation,
and reproducible analysis options, see the [`using-canregtools`
vignette](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/articles/using-canregtools.html).

# Package index

## Registry objects and data preparation

- [`as_canreg()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/as_canreg.md)
  : Construct a canreg object

- [`read_canreg()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/read_canreg.md)
  : Read cancer registration data

- [`as_fbswicd()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/as_fbswicd.md)
  :

  Construct `fbswicd` objects from summary data frames

- [`count_canreg()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/count_canreg.md)
  :

  Count and classify `canreg` data

- [`cr_clean()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_clean.md)
  : Clean canreg data.

- [`cr_combine()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_combine.md)
  : Combine cancer registry collections

- [`cr_filter()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_filter.md)
  : Filter rows from canregtools objects

- [`cr_merge()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_merge.md)
  :

  Merge elements from objects of class `canregs`, `fbswicds`, or `asrs`

- [`cr_map()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_map.md)
  : Set registry grouping mappings for cr_reframe

- [`cr_reframe()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_reframe.md)
  : Reframe data of class canregs or fbswicds

- [`cr_rename()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_rename.md)
  : Rename registries in a registry collection

- [`cr_select()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_select.md)
  :

  Select elements from objects with class `"canregs"`, or `"fbswicds"`

- [`esti_fbswicd()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/esti_fbswicd.md)
  : Estimate object of fbswicd

- [`esti_pop()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/esti_pop.md)
  : Estimating population structure using interpolation method.

- [`get_pop()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/get_pop.md)
  : Subset or summarize population data

## Validation

- [`validate_cases()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/validate_cases.md)
  [`validate_population()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/validate_cases.md)
  [`validate_canreg()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/validate_cases.md)
  [`validate_fbswicd()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/validate_cases.md)
  : Validate cancer registry data

- [`is_valid_canreg()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/is_valid_canreg.md)
  : Test whether a validation result contains no errors

- [`validate_canreg_report()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/validate_canreg_report.md)
  :

  Validate a `canreg_report` object

## Age splitting and rates

- [`calc_age()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/calc_age.md)
  : Calculate the actual age in completed years between two dates
- [`ageadjust()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/ageadjust.md)
  : Calculate the age standardized rate using the direct method
- [`benchmark_age_split()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/benchmark_age_split.md)
  : Blindly benchmark age-splitting methods against a single-age
  schedule
- [`create_age_rate()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/create_age_rate.md)
  : Calculate age specific rate
- [`create_asr()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/create_asr.md)
  : Calculate age-standardized rate (ASR)
- [`cumrate()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cumrate.md)
  : Calculate the cumulative incidence or mortality rate
- [`cumrisk()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cumrisk.md)
  : Calculate the cumulative risk
- [`cutage()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cutage.md)
  : Group ages into categories
- [`expand_age_pop()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/expand_age_pop.md)
  : Expand grouped population to single-year ages while preserving an
  open group
- [`expand_open_age_pop()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/expand_open_age_pop.md)
  : Expand one open-ended population age group
- [`expand_lx()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/expand_lx.md)
  : Expand a five-year abridged life table to a complete life table
- [`get_stdpop()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/get_stdpop.md)
  : Get standardized population data
- [`truncrate()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/truncrate.md)
  : Calculate truncated age standardized rate

## Quality and statistical comparisons

- [`create_quality()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/create_quality.md)
  : Calculate quality indicators
- [`compare_mi()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/compare_mi.md)
  : Compare mortality-to-incidence ratios across registries
- [`compare_mv()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/compare_mv.md)
  : Compare morphologically verified percentages across registries
- [`compare_rate()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/compare_rate.md)
  : Compare incidence or mortality rates
- [`cr_test()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_test.md)
  : Run cancer-registry quality tests
- [`detect_anomaly()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/detect_anomaly.md)
  : Detect unusual annual rates or quality indicators
- [`create_site_morp()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/create_site_morp.md)
  : Count ICD-10 site and morphology groups by strata

## Classification and labels

- [`add_labels()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/add_labels.md)
  : Add variable labels for data set.
- [`add_var_labels()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/add_var_labels.md)
  : Add Variable Labels with Units
- [`calc_ax()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/calc_ax.md)
  : Calculate ax for life table
- [`classify_areacode()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/classify_areacode.md)
  : Classify codes for the administrative divisions of China
- [`classify_childhood()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/classify_childhood.md)
  : Classify childhood cancer according to the ICCC3 standards
- [`classify_icd10()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/classify_icd10.md)
  : Classify ICD10 codes to cancer categories
- [`classify_morp()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/classify_morp.md)
  : Classify ICD-O-3 morphology codes into categories
- [`classify_topo()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/classify_topo.md)
  : Classify ICD-O-3 topography codes into categories
- [`combine_tp()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/combine_tp.md)
  : Sum named numeric vectors
- [`drop_others()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/drop_others.md)
  : Drop “other” cancer codes
- [`drop_total()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/drop_total.md)
  : Drop the total cancer
- [`tidy_age()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/tidy_age.md)
  : Tidy age description
- [`tidy_sex()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/tidy_sex.md)
  : Tidy gender variable
- [`tidy_var()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/tidy_var.md)
  : Reformat variable values for Cancer Registration in China

## Reports and visualization

- [`create_canreg_report_data()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/create_canreg_report_data.md)
  : Create a standardized cancer registry report data object

- [`create_report()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/create_report.md)
  : Render standardized cancer registry reports from built-in templates

- [`new_canreg_report()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/new_canreg_report.md)
  :

  Construct a `canreg_report` object

- [`draw_barchart()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/draw_barchart.md)
  : Draw Grouped Bar Charts with Facets

- [`draw_dumbbell()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/draw_dumbbell.md)
  : Plot dumbbell chart

- [`draw_linechart()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/draw_linechart.md)
  : Draw a Custom Line Chart Using Base R

- [`draw_pyramid()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/draw_pyramid.md)
  : Plot a population pyramid

## Dictionaries and utilities

- [`del_dict_files()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/del_dict_files.md)
  : Delete a dictionary file from canregtools config

- [`ls_attrs()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/ls_attrs.md)
  :

  list built-in attributes name used in
  [`cr_reframe()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/cr_reframe.md)

- [`ls_dict()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/ls_dict.md)
  : list dictionary used in package

- [`ls_dict_files()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/ls_dict_files.md)
  : List dictionary files used by canregtools

- [`ls_vars()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/ls_vars.md)
  : List variable names and their descriptions by category

- [`reset_dict()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/reset_dict.md)
  : Reset user dictionary overrides

- [`lt()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/lt.md) :
  Construct a life table from age-specific mortality rates

- [`write_regicode()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/write_regicode.md)
  : Write custom registry identifier labels to dictionary

- [`write_registry()`](https://gigu003.github.io/canregtools/reference/write_registry.md)
  : Write registry attributes to a user-defined dictionary

  Example Population-Based Cancer Registry Data (`canregs`)
